title: Package.resolved pin with no version
description: Package.resolved declares a resolved pin that records only a revision. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a resolved pin that records only a revision.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a resolved pin that records only a revision.
limitation: It matches a resolved pin that records only a revision in the parsed Package.resolved; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
